shots.alt: A checkweighing line with infeed and outfeed conveyors, a stainless checkweigher with a weight display, a reject pusher and bin, and a platform scale with a drum
Close-up of a stainless checkweigher with a carton on its weigh belt, photo-eye sensors and a weight indicator display on a pole
Close-up of a pneumatic reject pusher on the outfeed conveyor with a chute into a red reject bin holding a rejected carton
A blue drum on a checker-plate platform scale for batch weighing, with a weight indicator on a column
